description: Prep-only (NOT live) provider-agnostic WhatsApp API integration layer. Backend: add a nullable settings.whatsapp_api column (via an information_schema-guarded ensure* function mirroring ensureMasterPasswordColumn) and read/write it through the authenticated admin settings endpoint only (never the public /api/settings). Frontend: add a WhatsappApiConfig type + whatsappApi field to AdminSettings, create a dormant web/src/lib/waSender.ts whose single commented TODO fetch is the only remaining work, and build a settings form in AutoSendComingSoon.tsx (provider enum default 'none', base URL, masked access token, phone number id, Enabled switch OFF by default, and an inert 'Send test (coming soon)' button). Keep the free wa.me flow (lib/whatsapp.ts) the only active send path; make NO real network request; commit no secrets. Independent of FEAT-001 except both compile the web app; order it after FEAT-001 to keep per-FEAT builds clean.
steps: api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts: add `export async function ensureWhatsappApiColumn(): Promise<void>` mirroring ensureMasterPasswordColumn() exactly — SELECT COUNT(*) from information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='settings' AND column_name='whatsapp_api'; if present return; else `ALTER TABLE settings ADD COLUMN whatsapp_api TEXT NULL` inside try/catch that swallows MySQL duplicate-column (1060) errors.

api-node/src/server.ts: import ensureWhatsappApiColumn and call it in the boot seeding block alongside the other ensure* calls, using the same `.catch((e) => console.error(...))` style (fire-and-forget, non-blocking).

api-node/src/routes/admin.ts: extend settingsSchema (used by POST /settings) with `whatsappApi: z.object({ provider: z.enum(['none','cloud_api','custom']), baseUrl: z.string().trim().max(300), token: z.string().max(500), phoneNumberId: z.string().trim().max(120), enabled: z.boolean() }).partial().optional()`. In the raw-SQL UPDATE add `whatsapp_api=COALESCE(?,whatsapp_api)` and pass `s.whatsappApi ? JSON.stringify(s.whatsappApi) : null` as the matching parameter (keep COALESCE arg order aligned).

api-node/src/routes/admin.ts GET /settings handler: parse the row's whatsapp_api (`typeof row.whatsapp_api === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.whatsapp_api) : null`, tolerant of null/garbage) and return it as `whatsappApi`, defaulting to { provider:'none', baseUrl:'', phoneNumberId:'', enabled:false } (token '' when absent) when the column is null/empty. Do NOT add whatsapp_api to the public GET /api/settings in api-node/src/routes/catalog.ts.

web/src/lib/admin.ts: add `export interface WhatsappApiConfig { provider: 'none' | 'cloud_api' | 'custom'; baseUrl: string; token: string; phoneNumberId: string; enabled: boolean }` and add `whatsappApi?: WhatsappApiConfig` to the AdminSettings interface so fetchAdminSettings/saveAdminSettings carry it through (both are typed by AdminSettings).

Create NEW file web/src/lib/waSender.ts exporting: `export type WaMessage = { to: string; text: string }`; `export type WaSendResult = { ok: boolean; error?: string; detail?: unknown }`; `export async function sendViaApi(msg: WaMessage, cfg: WhatsappApiConfig): Promise<WaSendResult>` (import WhatsappApiConfig from './admin'). If !cfg || cfg.provider==='none' || !cfg.enabled return { ok:false, error:'WhatsApp API not configured yet' }. Otherwise leave EXACTLY ONE clearly-commented TODO fetch documenting the WhatsApp Cloud API shape (POST `${cfg.baseUrl}/${cfg.phoneNumberId}/messages`, header Authorization: Bearer ${cfg.token}, JSON body { messaging_product:'whatsapp', to: msg.to, type:'text', text:{ body: msg.text } }) and, below the TODO, return { ok:false, error:'WhatsApp API send not implemented yet' } so NO network request is made now. Add a header comment stating this module is dormant and lib/whatsapp.ts remains the active path. Do NOT call sendViaApi from any existing component.

web/src/pages/admin/marketing/AutoSendComingSoon.tsx: keep the honest-scaffold intro and add a config form below it. Load current config with react-query useQuery(['admin-settings'], fetchAdminSettings) and save with a mutation calling saveAdminSettings({ whatsappApi }) (mirror the useQuery+mutation pattern in AdminSettings.tsx; invalidate ['admin-settings'] on success and showToast). Fields with bilingual labels using inline styles consistent with the file: provider <select> (none default 'Band / Off', cloud_api 'WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)', custom); baseUrl text input; token input type="password" rendered MASKED (bullets or last-4 only, never raw); phoneNumberId text input; enabled checkbox/switch defaulting OFF. Add a 'Send test (coming soon when API added)' button that is disabled while provider==='none' || enabled===false and, even when enabled, only calls sendViaApi(...) and showToast()s the returned 'not implemented yet' message — it must never fire a real network request. Keep the 'link opened ≠ sent' honest copy.

Optional: update the single SUB_TABS label string in web/src/pages/admin/AdminMarketing.tsx from '🤖 Auto-send / AI (soon)' to a bilingual 'Auto-send / WhatsApp API' wording, but keep the `autosend` key and the AutoSendComingSoon import/component name unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\api-node (tsc) passes with no errors, and `npm test` in api-node still passes.
Running `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\web exits cleanly with no TypeScript errors.

settings.whatsapp_api is created idempotently at boot (information_schema-guarded ALTER, 1060 swallowed); GET /api/admin/settings returns whatsappApi (default provider 'none', enabled false) and POST /api/admin/settings persists it; the public GET /api/settings does NOT include whatsapp_api.

web/src/lib/waSender.ts returns a clear 'not configured yet' result when provider==='none' or disabled and makes NO network request; it contains exactly one commented TODO fetch with the WhatsApp Cloud API request shape.

AutoSendComingSoon shows the settings form: provider defaults to none, Enabled defaults OFF, the token is masked in the UI, the config round-trips through save/reload, and the 'Send test' button is inert when provider is none or disabled and never performs a real network call.
The free wa.me flow (lib/whatsapp.ts) remains unchanged and the only active send path; no secret value is committed.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\api-node and `npm test` in api-node; confirm both pass.
Run `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\web and confirm a clean exit.

Manual check after build: open Auto-send / WhatsApp API tab, confirm defaults (none/OFF), masked token, save+reload round-trip, and that the Send test button is disabled when provider none/disabled and triggers no network request when enabled.
findings: Implemented PREP-ONLY (not live). BACKEND: api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts adds ensureWhatsappApiColumn() mirroring ensureMasterPasswordColumn() exactly (information_schema COUNT guard on settings.whatsapp_api; ALTER TABLE settings ADD COLUMN whatsapp_api TEXT NULL in try/catch that swallows 1060/Duplicate column). api-node/src/server.ts imports it and calls ensureWhatsappApiColumn().catch(console.error) in the boot block right after ensureMasterPasswordColumn() (fire-and-forget). api-node/src/routes/admin.ts: settingsSchema extended with whatsappApi: z.object({provider: z.enum(['none','cloud_api','custom']), baseUrl: max300, token: max500, phoneNumberId: max120, enabled: boolean}).partial().optional(); POST /settings UPDATE adds whatsapp_api=COALESCE(?,whatsapp_api) as the LAST column with param s.whatsappApi ? JSON.stringify(s.whatsappApi) : null (COALESCE arg order preserved); GET /settings parses row.whatsapp_api tolerantly (typeof string + non-empty, JSON.parse in try/catch, invalid provider coerced to 'none', !!enabled) and returns whatsappApi, defaulting to {provider:'none',baseUrl:'',token:'',phoneNumberId:'',enabled:false}. catalog.ts public GET /api/settings was NOT touched — token never leaks publicly. FRONTEND: web/src/lib/admin.ts exports interface WhatsappApiConfig and adds optional whatsappApi?: WhatsappApiConfig to AdminSettings (carried by fetch/saveAdminSettings). NEW web/src/lib/waSender.ts is DORMANT: WaMessage/WaSendResult types + sendViaApi(msg,cfg) that returns {ok:false,error:'WhatsApp API not configured yet'} when !cfg||provider==='none'||!enabled, otherwise has EXACTLY ONE commented TODO fetch documenting the WhatsApp Cloud API shape (POST ${baseUrl}/${phoneNumberId}/messages, Authorization: Bearer ${token}, body {messaging_product:'whatsapp',to,type:'text',text:{body}}) and returns {ok:false,error:'WhatsApp API send not implemented yet'} — NO network request. A `void msg;` keeps the param honest (unused until wired). web/src/pages/admin/marketing/AutoSendComingSoon.tsx keeps the honest scaffold and adds a bilingual config form: useQuery(['admin-settings'],fetchAdminSettings) + save via saveAdminSettings({whatsappApi}) with qc.invalidateQueries(['admin-settings']) + showToast; provider <select> (none='Band / Off' default, cloud_api, custom), baseUrl text, token type=password rendered MASKED (last-4 via maskToken, raw never shown; only overwrites stored token when user types this session via tokenDirty flag), phoneNumberId text, enabled checkbox default OFF, and an inert 'Send test (coming soon when API added)' button disabled while provider==='none'||!enabled that only calls sendViaApi() and toasts the returned not-implemented message (never a real network call). AdminMarketing.tsx SUB_TABS label changed to '🤖 Auto-send / WhatsApp API' (key 'autosend' + import/component name unchanged). SIDE EDIT required for web tsc: AdminSettings.tsx StoreSettings state-map type now also Excludes 'whatsappApi' (alongside existing 'masterPasswordSet') since that tab doesn't edit it — the Marketing Auto-send tab owns whatsappApi. lib/whatsapp.ts untouched (still the only active send path). No secrets committed; no new dependencies. VERIFICATION: web `npm run build` exits 0 (tsc -b + vite build clean). api-node `npm test` passes (46/46). api-node `npm run build` (tsc) does NOT pass in THIS environment, but ONLY due to a PRE-EXISTING blocker unrelated to FEAT-002: 8 errors 'Property shortLink does not exist on PrismaClient' in src/routes/admin-links.ts, src/routes/link.ts, src/services/shortLink.ts (files not touched by FEAT-002). The committed Prisma schema HAS `model ShortLink @@map('short_links')` but the generated client in node_modules/.prisma/client is STALE (no ShortLink) and `prisma generate` cannot run here because the Prisma binaries CDN (binaries.prisma.sh) returns 403 Forbidden behind corporate TLS inspection (even with system CA bundle + --no-engine). INTEGRATION/REVIEW ACTION NEEDED: run `npx prisma generate` in api-node on a machine with network access to regenerate the client, after which api-node `npm run build` should pass — none of the FEAT-002-edited files (admin.ts/server.ts/dataImport.ts) produce any tsc error.
